title: Onramp Entryframe & Microflow Kit — compact landing visuals and screenshot pipeline
creator: Asha Nair
description: Objective: Produce a compact 'entryframe' system for the Quickstart landing that combines a small-viewport hero, progressive step microflows, and a repeatable product-screenshot pipeline. Deliver a modular pack of assets (SVGs, Lottie snippets, annotated PNGs), a documentation page for engineers, and an accessibility review. Key constraints: keep first meaningful paint under 550ms on 3G-emulated mobile, support localization for EN/DE/FR/JP, and prepare assets for Console release console-2026.03.
deliverables: Entryframe hero variants: compact (mobile), mid (tablet), expanded (desktop)
Step microflow system: 3-panel progressive reveal + collapsed view for low-bandwidth
Screenshot capture checklist and naming scheme for CI pipeline
Interaction spec: hover/focus/keyboard states, animation timing tokens
Confluence design spec + production tokens file
Engineer's implementation guide with asset URLs and alt-texts
acceptance_criteria: All hero variants implemented and visually consistent with design tokens
Microflow stepset animates within 250ms on desktop; animation disabled on 3G-mobile emulation
Screenshot pipeline yields pixel-perfect frames for desktop/tablet/mobile per spec
Accessibility: hero contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, keyboard focus order verified, screen-reader labels provided
Localization: copy blocks accept translations without layout break at 120% length
Design spec and assets linked in Confluence and referenced in PR description
tasks: Finalize hero composition and responsive grid (Marisol) — deliver Figma page
Define microflow choreography and Lottie keyframes (Motion team) — prototype JSON
Write screenshot capture checklist and CI step (Design + ENG)
Create alt-text and aria guidance for engineering
Run performance smoke tests on 3G and record TTFP/TTI
Coordinate i18n copy lengths with PM for EN/DE/FR/JP
